label: G F41#16 base-vs-arm
brief: Two in-game frames (stacked) of the screen just after the player's creature loses a wild fight, with the result card on screen, at 1920x1080. Judge the interface on a 7-inch handheld screen: whether the result reads at a glance, what else on screen competes with it, and fit to the game's UI direction.
defects: After the creature falls a large out-of-fight message appears over the exploration HUD while TEAM 5/5 and green party bars still look ready and no distinct loss result is shown
